new_string: - [DONE] Phase 2 / Builder 7 — bot LLM intercept (Pattern A button-flow) + step-aware flag + stopOnModalOpened. New: `src/lib/slack/modals/intercept.ts` (421 LOC) exports `interceptCreateForModal()`, `stopOnModalOpened` StopCondition predicate, `extractInterceptedProposals()`, and `composeButtonBearingReply()` (single/multi/mixed read+create reply composition incl. project-first sort + disabled-task-button when project staged in same batch). New: `src/lib/slack/intercept.test.ts` (473 LOC, 25 tests) — replaces spike-c-termination.test.ts with retargeted tests against the production helpers (spike file remained untracked in parent worktree, NOT carried into builder-7 branch). Modified: `src/lib/slack/bot-tools.ts` — `createBotTools(userName, now, options?)` now accepts optional `{convoState, context}`; the 3 INTERCEPT_ALLOWLIST tools (`create_project`/`create_week_item`/`create_team_member`) check feature flag + presence of convoState/context and route to `interceptCreateForModal()` first, falling through to legacy direct-write (`source: "bot-direct"`) otherwise. Modified: `src/lib/slack/bot.ts` — generates per-call `intentGroupId`, builds `convoState`, threads them through `createBotTools`, adds `prepareStep` callback to track step number into `convoState.currentStep`, adds `stopOnModalOpened` to `stopWhen: [stepCountIs(MAX_STEPS), stopOnModalOpened]`, post-loop branches on `extractInterceptedProposals(result)` to either single button-bearing chat.postMessage (with reply.text + reply.blocks) or legacy text-only reply. Added `create_team_member` to `MUTATION_TOOLS` (was missing per Builder 0a follow-up). Tests: 2568 passed / 19 skipped (+21 net new vs Phase 1 baseline of 2547). Lint: 0 errors / 11 pre-existing warnings. Commit sha: b709f5d. **Out-of-scope follow-ups:** (1) `posted_message_ts` / `posted_message_channel` not yet persisted on intercepted proposals after `chat.postMessage` returns — Wave 8's chat.update flow needs them; add an `updatePostedMessage(proposalId, ts, channel)` helper to `proposal.ts` and call it from `bot.ts` post-postMessage. (2) `composeButtonBearingReply` exports `BotReply`/`ReplyBlock` types but is not yet imported from Wave 8 (Builder 8) — Builder 8 will reuse the same composer for the multi-detect chat.update re-emit path. (3) `prepareStep` callback returns `{}` (no-op overrides) — if Wave 9 needs per-step model/tools tweaks, extend there. (4) `MODEL = "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001"` in bot.ts:39 was flagged by the ai-gateway validator hook (suggests dot-versioning); pre-existing line, pinned by CLAUDE.md, out of scope.
